metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflow

plugins.name: task-tracker
plugins.description: Lightweight task/ticket tracker using TSV files and shell scripts

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Guides creation and review of Claude Code Agent Skills with standardized workflows and quality checklists

plugins.name: checking-oss-release
plugins.description: Checks open source projects for security leaks, privacy issues, and license compliance before release

plugins.name: designing-test-cases
plugins.description: Guides systematic test case design using established testing techniques

plugins.name: wsl-notify
plugins.description: Windows desktop notifications for Claude Code via wsl-relay — alerts on task completion and permission prompts

plugins.name: hardening-dev-environment
plugins.description: Hardens Claude Code dev environments: pnpm supply-chain config + npx-to-pnpm-dlx migration; .claude/settings.json permission deny/ask rules + PreToolUse hooks (credential reads, package.json scripts tampering); PostToolUse trust-boundary reminder for non-vendor WebFetch results
